lead: Feather Touch Foundation School and Day Care Centre is a nurturing early childhood education centre dedicated to providing quality foundational education in a safe, caring and stimulating environment.
paragraphs: Our school caters to young learners during their most important developmental years through a combination of play-based learning, structured classroom experiences, creative activities and social interaction.
We believe that education at this stage should not be about pressure or rote learning. It should be about curiosity, discovery, confidence and joy.
vision: To create a happy, safe and stimulating learning environment where every child gets the opportunity to discover their potential, develop confidence and build strong foundations for lifelong learning.
mission: To provide quality early childhood education.
To nurture every child's individual strengths and interests.
To make learning joyful, experiential and meaningful.
To develop communication, creativity and problem-solving skills.
To promote positive social behaviour and emotional development.
To create awareness about kindness, respect, responsibility and safety.
To build a strong partnership between school and parents.

approach.header: We Believe Children Learn Best When They Are Happy.
approach.lead: At Feather Touch, classrooms are not just places where children sit and listen. They are spaces where children explore, experiment, ask questions, create and discover.

methods.name: Activity-Based Learning
methods.text: Children understand concepts through activities and real-life experiences.

methods.name: Experiential Learning
methods.text: We encourage children to learn by doing.

methods.name: Role Play
methods.text: Role play develops imagination, communication and confidence.

methods.name: Story-Based Learning
methods.text: Stories make language, values and concepts easier and more enjoyable to understand.

methods.name: Music & Movement
methods.text: Rhymes, songs and movement support language, memory and physical development.

methods.name: Art & Creativity
methods.text: Creative activities help children express ideas and emotions.

methods.name: Nature & Environmental Learning
methods.text: Children are encouraged to observe and understand the world around them.

development.lead: At Feather Touch, we guide young minds across all essential dimensions of early growth.

areas.name: Language Development
areas.text: Listening, speaking, vocabulary and early literacy.

areas.name: Physical Development
areas.text: Balance, coordination, movement and motor skills.

areas.name: Social Development
areas.text: Sharing, cooperation, empathy and positive relationships.

safety.heading: A Safe Childhood is the First Step Towards a Strong Future
safety.lead: At Feather Touch, the safety and well-being of every child is a fundamental priority.
safety.commitmentNote: We also believe that child protection is a shared responsibility between school, parents and the community.

partnership.heading: Parents + Teachers = Stronger Foundations
partnership.lead: A child's development becomes stronger when parents and teachers work together.
